cat > programs/task-20d4f687.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    # Extend the diagonal arm of the non-background color to the edge.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 4]
    # Determine the diagonal object color and extension direction from its existing diagonal pair.
    color = max(set(v for r,c,v in cells), key=lambda v: sum(1 for _,_,x in cells if x == v))
    pts = [(r,c) for r,c,v in cells if v == color]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # A diagonal ray is continued from the point lying at the end of a matching diagonal segment.
    for r,c in pts:
        for dr,dc in [(-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1)]:
            if (r-dr,c-dc) in pts and (r+dr,c+dc) not in pts:
                rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == 4:
                    out[rr][cc]=color
                    rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    return out
PY
